<form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} data-testid="transfer-form">
          <Form layout="vertical" component={false}>
            <Controller
              control={control}
              name="fromAccountId"
              render={({ field, fieldState: { error } }) => (
                <Form.Item
                  label="转出账户"
                  validateStatus={error ? 'error' : ''}
                  help={error?.message}
                >
                  <Select
                    data-testid="transfer-source-account"
                    value={field.value || undefined}
                    onChange={field.onChange}
                    placeholder="请选择转出账户"
                    loading={accountsQuery.isLoading}
                    options={accountOptions}
                  />
                </Form.Item>
              )}
            />

            <Controller
              control={control}
              name="beneficiaryId"
              render={({ field, fieldState: { error } }) => (
                <Form.Item
                  label="收款人"
                  validateStatus={error ? 'error' : ''}
                  help={error?.message}
                >
                  <Select
                    data-testid="transfer-beneficiary"
                    value={field.value || undefined}
                    onChange={field.onChange}
                    placeholder="请选择收款人"
                    loading={beneficiariesQuery.isLoading}
                    options={beneficiaryOptions}
                  />
                </Form.Item>
              )}
            />

<Controller
              control={control}
              name="amount"
              render={({ field, fieldState: { error } }) => (
                <Form.Item
                  label="转账金额"
                  validateStatus={error ? 'error' : ''}
                  help={error?.message}
                >
                  <InputNumber
                    data-testid="transfer-amount"
                    value={field.value || undefined}
                    onChange={(v: number | null) => field.onChange(v ?? 0)}
                    style={{ width: '100%' }}
                    prefix={currency}
                    placeholder="请输入转账金额"
                    min={0.01}
                    precision={2}
                  />
                </Form.Item>
              )}
            />

            <Controller
              control={control}
              name="description"
              render={({ field, fieldState: { error } }) => (
                <Form.Item
                  label="备注（选填）"
                  validateStatus={error ? 'error' : ''}
                  help={error?.message}
                >
                  <TextArea
                    data-testid="transfer-description"
                    value={field.value}
                    onChange={field.onChange}
                    rows={3}
                    placeholder="请输入转账备注"
                    maxLength={200}
                    showCount
                  />
                </Form.Item>
              )}
            />

            {selectedAccount !== undefined && (
              <Text type="secondary" style={{ display: 'block', marginBottom: 16 }}>
                当前余额：{selectedAccount.balance} {selectedAccount.currency}
              </Text>
            )}
); }

services:

    restart: always
    env_file:

      - ./.env
    healthcheck:

      retries: 10
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
  # Messaging service for Manager-Worker communication
  activemq:
    image: apache/activemq-classic:latest

    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "nc", "-z", "localhost", "61616"]    
  # Backend service
  fineract-server:
    image: openmf/fineract:${TAG}
    volumes:
      - ./fineract-server/data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", 'sh', '-c', 'echo -e "Checking for the availability of Fineract server deployment"; while ! nc -z "fineract-server" 8080; do sleep 1; printf "-"; done; echo -e " >> Fineract server has started";' ]
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 10
    ports:
      - ${FINERACT_PORT:-300

0}:8080

      - FINERACT_HIKARI_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT=20000

      - FINERACT_HIKARI_DS_PROPERTIES_CACHE_PREP_STMTS=true
      - FINERACT_HIKARI_DS_PROPERTIES_PREP_STMT_CACHE_SIZE=250

      - FINERACT_HIKARI_DS_PROPERTIES_USE_SERVER_PREP_STMTS=true
      - FINERACT_HIKARI_DS_PROPERTIES_USE_LOCAL_SESSION_STATE=true
      - FINERACT_HIKARI_DS_PROPERTIES_REWRITE_BATCHED_STATEMENTS=true
      - FINERACT_HIKARI_DS_PROPERTIES_CACHE_RESULT_SET_METADATA=true
      - FINERACT_HIKARI_DS_PROPERTIES_CACHE_SERVER_CONFIGURATION=true
      - FINERACT_HIKARI_DS_PROPERTIES_ELIDE_SET_AUTO_COMMITS=true
      - FINERACT_HIKARI_DS_PROPERTIES_MAINTAIN_TIME_STATS=false
      - FINERACT_HIKARI_DS_PROPERTIES_LOG_SLOW_QUERIES=true
      - FINERACT_HIKARI_DS_PROPERTIES_DUMP_QUERIES_IN_EXCEPTION=true
      # NOTE: env vars prefixed "FINERACT_DEFAULT_TENANTDB_*" are used
 to create the default tenant database
      - FINERACT_DEFAULT_TENANTDB_HOSTNAME=postgresql
      - FINERACT_DEFAULT_TENANTDB_PORT=5432
      - FINERACT_DEFAULT_TENANTDB_UID=postgres
      - FINERACT_DEFAULT_TENANTDB_PWD=${PG_PASSWORD}
      - FINERACT_DEFAULT_TENANTDB_CONN_PARAMS=
      - FINERACT_DEFAULT_TENANTDB_TIMEZONE=Asia/Kolkata
      - FINERACT_DEFAULT_TENANTDB_IDENTIFIER=default
      - FINERACT_DEFAULT_TENANTDB_NAME=fineract_default
      - FINERACT_DEFAULT_TENANTDB_DESCRIPTION=Default Demo Tenant
      - FINERACT_SERVER_SSL_ENABLED=false
      - FINERACT_SERVER_PORT=8080
      - FINERACT_LOGGING_LEVEL=INFO
      - FINERACT_MODE=${FINERACT_MANAGER_MODE:-WRITE}
      - FINERACT_MESSAGING_ACTIVEMQ_BROKER_URL=${FINERACT_MESSAGING_ACTIVEMQ_BROKER_URL}
      - FINERACT_REPORT_ENGINE_BIRT_ENABLED=${FINERACT_REPORT_ENGINE_BIRT_ENABLED}
  # Scalable Worker service (Read-only nodes)
  fineract-worker:
    image: openmf/fineract:${TAG}
    depends_on:
      fineract-server:
        condition: service_healthy
    deploy:
      mode: replicated
      replicas: ${FINERACT_WORKERS_COUNT:-0}
    environment:
      - FINERACT_MODE=${FINERACT_WORKER_MODE:-READ}
      - FINERACT_HIKARI_DRIVER_SOURCE_CLASS_NAME=org.postgresql.Driver
      - FINERACT_HIKARI_JDBC_URL=jdbc:postgresql://postgresql:5432/fineract_tenants
      - FINERACT_HIKARI_USERNAME=postgres
      - FINERACT_HIKARI_PASSWORD=${FINERACT_DB_PASS}
      - FINERACT_MESSAGING_ACTIVEMQ_BROKER_URL=${FINERACT_MESSAGING_ACTIVEMQ_BROKER_URL}

databaseChangeLog:
  - changeSet:
      id: v2-p1-transfer-status-contract
      author: BankingDomainAgent
      comment: Replace pre-v4 transfer states without changing monetary records.
      changes:
        - sql:
            splitStatements: false
            sql: |
              UPDATE transfer SET status = CASE status
                WHEN 'VALIDATING' THEN 'RISK_PENDING'
                WHEN 'RISK_REVIEW' THEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'
                WHEN 'PENDING_APPROVAL' THEN 'APPROVED'
                WHEN 'PENDING_CORE_POSTING' THEN 'RESERVED'
                WHEN 'PENDING_CLEARING' THEN 'SUBMITTED'
                ELSE status END
              WHERE status IN ('VALIDATING','RISK_REVIEW','PENDING_APPROVAL','PENDING_CORE_POSTING','PENDING_CLEARING');
              UPDATE transfer_state_history SET from_status = CASE from_status
                WHEN 'VALIDATING' THEN 'RISK_PENDING' WHEN 'RISK_REVIEW' THEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'
                WHEN 'PENDING_APPROVAL' THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN 'PENDING_CORE_POSTING' THEN 'RESERVED'
                WHEN 'PENDING_CLEARING' THEN 'SUBMITTED' ELSE from_status END;
              UPDATE transfer_state_history SET to_status = CASE to_status
                WHEN 'VALIDATING' THEN 'RISK_PENDING' WHEN 'RISK_REVIEW' THEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'
                WHEN 'PENDING_APPROVAL' THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN 'PENDING_CORE_POSTING' THEN 'RESERVED'
                WHEN 'PENDING_CLEARING' THEN 'SUBMITTED' ELSE to_status END;
